name: Detached ADU vs garage conversion: which is better for Los Angeles lots?

mainEntity.name: Is a detached ADU better than a garage conversion in Los Angeles for resale value, privacy, and rental use?
mainEntity.text: Is a detached ADU better than a garage conversion in Los Angeles for resale value, privacy, and rental use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Detached ADUs and garage conversions solve different problems. A detached ADU usually delivers stronger privacy, better separation from the main home, and a more marketable rental or guest space. It also allows more freedom in layout, ceiling height, windows, and exterior design. A garage conversion often wins on speed and cost because the shell already exists, which can reduce foundation and framing work. The decision should start with the property itself. If the lot has usable yard space and the owner wants a premium, standalone living space, detached construction is often the better long-term choice. If the goal is to minimize cost and construction time, conversion may be the smarter path. Homeowners should compare not only build price, but also rental appeal, site disruption, parking impact, and future resale positioning. The best answer is usually property-specific rather than universal.
acceptedAnswer.description: A detached ADU usually offers better privacy, stronger rental appeal, and more design flexibility, while a garage conversion is often cheaper and faster. The better option depends on yard space, existing structures, budget, and whether the property can support new construction.
